answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 40968 Country: India Title: What is the significant of 786 numbers Question: What is the significant of 786 numbers? As we see generally people use this number either suffix or prefix in their mobile no or car no. Does this lead to any benefit or it is just a myth? Answer ID: 40968 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1275/844/H=1433) It is not a myth. However, it has the importance that its numbers are of بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم as per the counting of Abjad. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
